# How many employees does CompanyCam have?

CompanyCam, Inc. has approximately400 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.CompanyCam’s total headcount has grown65.5% from 242 employees in 2023 to 400 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is CompanyCam hiring right now?

Yes, CompanyCam isactively hiring. CompanyCam had42 active job postings in 2026, a 84.7% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/companycam/employees#postings).

## About CompanyCam’s Workforce

CompanyCam, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **400** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 5th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/companycam/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2014, the company is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska.

CompanyCam's workforce has grown **65.5%** from 2023 to 2026, though it is down **3.4%** year over year in 2026. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America ( **99.7%**), followed by Pacific Islands ( **0.3%**).

CompanyCam's functional groups are Finance and Operations ( **39.8%**), Engineering ( **35.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **24.2%**), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest (up **5.5%**). The average salary is **$110,347,** highest in North America at a median of **$99,000,** up **3.0%** year over year in 2026.

CompanyCam's active job postings rose **84.7%** in 2026 to **42**, with new postings per month climbing from **11** in 2023 to **28** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is negative and declining.
